requirements.command: bcs-cli create-group + establish group and Session identifiers
requirements.expectation: Create the exact CLI group-context workspace using the owned Human Cookie and dedicated driver Bot, and retain the returned group ID and current session ID for the remaining obligations.
Add one deterministic group-scope context with exact visibility and collect-from policy, and receive an ok acknowledgement from the product CLI.
Add one deterministic session-scope context under the same Group Context story using the current active Session and receive an ok acknowledgement.
Add one deterministic round-scope context under the same Group Context story using the current active Session and one exact round identifier, and receive an ok acknowledgement.
Read the exact initial group-scope context entry and confirm the returned items array contains the exact context name and content unique to this run.
Update the exact group-scope context entry with the updated content and receive an ok acknowledgement from the product CLI.
List all three scope levels and validate that the context name appears with owner permission, without mixing unrelated contexts into the story evidence.
Read the exact updated group-scope context entry and confirm the returned items array now contains the updated content and the exact run-local context name.
Delete the exact workspace group created for this story and confirm HTTP 200, without deleting any unrelated Group or Session.
